integrity: The support-function classification is derived using explicitly cited existing harmonic lemmas, not asserted as new. The original claim is the ten-dimensional range/inversion, orthogonal norm identity and coherent-center rigidity. The embedded checker corroborates only finite exact identities; universal validity is proved analytically.
limitations: Reconstruction from all threefold-symmetric projection centers has an unavoidable constant-width-radius ambiguity. The theorem requires all planar directions; it does not quantify noisy/finite-view stability. Equivalent unindexed literature may exist.
title: Projection-center tomography of threefold-symmetric shadows in \(\mathbb R^3\)
